opticalFindings: PROJECT preserves crisp photographic diamond texture on all seven letters. Fine vector scintillation stays on small face-mounted points; no background stars or broad opaque glare obscure lettering.
DOLLAR preserves warm polished gold, dark counters and bevel depth. Low-opacity clipped warmth/reflections add sunlight without flattening the original shading.
The original green moneybag, gold rope and dollar symbol remain intact and readable; the new overlays exclude the bag.
The uninterrupted casting frames a larger visible field and authentic league mark; the recessed sapphire channel leaves the polished metal readable.
Readable translucent entry artwork and icon-only glass selectors stay unobscured. All four selector circuits use fixed sport hues and remain independent of the selected room hue.

Current genuine WPE393/430 originals pass the brand/material hierarchy. Its selector glass reveals a sharper floor pattern than Chromium's blurred glass, while staying translucent and readable; cross-engine pixel identity is not claimed.
The current closed Chromium430 source/boot companion retains the same crisp brand, localized sapphire channel, readable translucent Enter, and four glass selectors seen in the prior natural sequence.
